sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Pilgerodendron uviferum is a dioecious evergreen conifer of southern Chile and south-western Argentina, in subantarctic forests and wet bogs. It can reach about 20 m.

sections.title: Leaves and cones
sections.text: The opposite, decussate scale leaves are about 2–4 mm long and give the branchlets a four-sided section. The globose female cones are about 8–10 mm across and have pointed scales.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: The wood has been used for construction, posts and boats. No food use is documented.
